scope: Bounded RF/analog exact-package review, 2026-09-07. Electrical pin types only; no production changes or whole-circuit sign-off. Numbered physical maps were compared with current devices.json and H2-R2 contact materialization. Analog/RF matching, bias, common-mode range, stability, gain, thermal paths and operating states require separate verification. An open-collector type also represents open-drain in the supported KiCad pin-type vocabulary.

evidence.section: Rev. C, Figure 2 RM-8 pin configuration and Table 3; specifications for V_UP/V_DN; Filter Capacitor section. ARMZ is MSOP, not the exposed-pad LFCSP option.

1.reason: RFIN detector RF input; internally AC coupled, not a logic input.

2.reason: ENBL enable control; high enables the detector.

3.reason: VSET analog setpoint input; detector mode feeds it from V_UP.

6.reason: V_UP buffered logarithmic detector voltage output.

7.reason: V_DN inverted/scaled analog output, not a supply source.

devices.physical_map_review: Numbered functions 1..8 match the current contact map; RM-8 has no exposed pad.
unresolved: Pin 4 FLTR is the external compensation-capacitor terminal to V_UP. Its function is verified, but a simple input/output electrical direction is not established; it is deliberately omitted from reviewed pins rather than marked passive as a placeholder.
Detector feedback, filter stability, ADC range, RF loading and disabled-state behavior remain outside this pin-type review.

2.reason: EN mixer enable voltage input; must not float.

3.reason: IN+ differential signal input of the active mixer.

4.reason: IN- differential signal input of the active mixer.

5.reason: OUT- differential open-collector mixer output; external DC bias through its load is required.

6.reason: OUT+ differential open-collector mixer output; not a push-pull logic or supply output.

devices.physical_map_review: All numbered functions including exposed ground pad 9 match current devices.json and materialized pads.
unresolved: Open-collector typing does not prove the analog output load/bias path: both output collectors require the reviewed transformer/inductor or resistor feed, valid common-mode voltage and current limits.
Mixer input bias return, LO level, matching and frequency conversion remain separate analog checks.

unresolved: Gain/offset feedback, output/ADC loading and RF input DC blocking need circuit-level verification.

evidence.section: PGA-103+ Simplified Schematic and Pin Description; recommended application Figure 2a. Manufacturer-indexed content identifies 1 RF-IN, 2/4 GND, 3 RF-OUT and DC-IN; direct PDF download returned HTTP 403 in this review.

1.reason: RF-IN amplifier input; source is externally DC blocked.

2.reason: Ground; H2 materializes manufacturer GND pins 2 and 4 together as SOT-89-3 pad 2.

3.reason: RF-OUT and DC-IN share this pad. Type records mandatory external DC bias input, not RF-output direction.

devices.physical_map_review: All four documented RF/bias/ground functions match devices.json. H2 explicitly maps both GND_1 (manufacturer 2) and GND_2 (manufacturer 4) to the one contiguous SOT-89-3 ground pad numbered 2, so the reviewed native pin types have only three keys; no invented fourth KiCad pad.
unresolved: Pad 3 has simultaneous analog-output and power-input roles; a single KiCad pin type cannot express both. Verify the DC feed through the bias choke and RF output/DC block separately; this pin must never be treated as a self-powered power_out.
This pin review is not proof of LNA stability, matching, gain, noise figure, bias current or thermal adequacy.

devices.physical_map_review: All numbered functions 1..8 match current devices.json and were visually checked. Exact AYCR is U-DFN3030-8 Type E, not MSOP/SO8. The central pad is a separate unresolved item.
unresolved: The exact U-DFN3030-8E has a central exposed pad, shown without a pin number or electrical assignment in DS41333. Current RF U86 speaker_amp footprint has an unnumbered 1.60x2.35-mm copper/paste pad; H2 materialization excludes it from electrical contacts. Its permitted electrical connection and thermal implementation need exact manufacturer/package evidence. Do not invent pad9=GND or count this unnumbered pad as electrically verified.
BTL load connection, shutdown level, supply filtering, output EMI and dissipation require circuit/layout verification.
